subject: MAP: Security review milestone & SOC 2 evidence delivery — proposed schedule
messages:
From: Marta Lopez <marta@novafin.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: security@novafin.com, diego.ramos@novafin.com
Date: 2026-11-20T10:02:00Z
Subject: Re: Intro + quick follow-up on Redwood capabilities

Thanks for the call earlier, Karthik — that was helpful. Two quick asks so we can move forward on our side: 1) a concrete mutual action plan (MAP) we can share with procurement that lists milestones, owners, and dates; 2) a SOC 2 evidence checklist + sample artifacts so our security team can triage.

We are targeting an internal security review week of Dec 7 (we'll confirm exact slot) and would like to have materials to review a week in advance if possible. Can you propose dates/owners for the MAP milestones (security review / evidence delivery / legal review / procurement approval) and confirm whether Redwood has a SOC 2 package we can reference?

Thanks — Marta
Head of IT Risk, Novafin

--
Marta Lopez
Novafin

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: Marta Lopez <marta@novafin.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-20T14:28:00Z
Subject: MAP: Security review milestone & SOC 2 evidence delivery — proposed schedule

Marta — thanks for the thoughtful questions and for the time today. Attaching a first-pass MAP workbook (MAP-Novafin-20261120.xlsx) and a short SOC 2 overview PDF. Below is a concise plan specifically for the security review milestone so it's clear who does what and by when.

Proposed MAP security milestone (summary):
- Milestone: Novafin security review of Redwood SOC 2 package
  - Owner (Redwood): karthik_iyer (sales lead) / neha_kapoor (compliance engineer)
  - Owner (Novafin): Marta Lopez / Novafin Security Team (security@novafin.com)
  - Deliverables: SOC 2 report (summary), evidence index (CSV), controls mapping document, sample logs/schemas as attachments
  - Proposed Redwood delivery date: 2026-11-30 (evidence index + sample artifacts)
  - Novafin review window: 2026-12-07 to 2026-12-11
  - Dependency: delivery of signed NDA or minimal SSO test credentials if Novafin needs live audit access (note this only applies to a small subset of artifacts)

Notes / asks for you:
1) Is Dec 7 a hard review start or flexible within that week? We can shift delivery two business days earlier if needed.
2) Which artifacts are must-haves vs nice-to-have for your reviewers — we included a templated evidence list (evidence-list-template.csv) in the workbook so you can mark priorities.

Next steps (suggested):
- I will share the MAP workbook link and upload the three starter artifacts to the shared Drive today.
- Neha will prepare an evidence index and two sample artifacts (IAM policy snippet, sanitized access logs) by 2026-11-30.
- Laura will coordinate legal/procurement touchpoints for the contract timeline and DocuSign link.

Target commercial close (tentative): 2026-12-21, assuming review + procurement proceed on schedule. We'll mark that as a working target in the MAP.

If that looks good I can convert the workbook to a DocuSign-enabled MAP and send to your procurement team.

Best —
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: laura_bennett@redwood.com
To: neha_kapoor@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-20T16:05:00Z
Subject: Fwd: MAP: Security review milestone & SOC 2 evidence delivery — proposed schedule

Folks — looping you in. Marta asked explicitly for a prioritized evidence list. Neha, can you prepare the evidence-index CSV and flag the 8 items we can ship by 11/30 (IAM policy, data retention policy excerpt, sample audit log, encryption key management doc extract, network diagram, SOC 2 summary, vendor list, incident response runbook excerpt)? Laura - I'll manage the contract cadence and prepare the initial DocuSign envelope targeting the Dec 21 close.

Quick internal timelines:
- Neha: draft evidence-index + sample artifacts by 2026-11-30 (solid)
- Legal (Laura): initial contract out by 2026-12-06; procurement sign-off target 2026-12-18
- Sales (Karthik): keep Novafin engaged for the review week starting Dec 7 and ensure we have clarifying notes for each evidence item

Thanks —
Laura
VP, Commercial Operations, Redwood Inference

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: Marta Lopez <marta@novafin.com>, security@novafin.com, diego.ramos@novafin.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-24T09:12:00Z
Subject: Updated MAP and evidence checklist attached (ready for your review)

Marta / Novafin team — attaching the updated MAP workbook and the evidence-list-template.csv with the items we can provide immediately highlighted (column: "availability"). For visibility I also included a short comment for each item explaining sensitivity and whether it will be a redacted excerpt vs a full artifact. Attachments: MAP-Novafin-20261120.xlsx, evidence-list-template.csv, Redwood_SOC2_Overview.pdf.

High-level callouts:
- Deliverable date for highlighted artifacts: 2026-11-30 (we will ship via secure Drive folder).
- If you need live logs or L1 access for validation we require a short SSO test account — please confirm if your reviewers need that and we can prepare a time-limited account.
- Legal/procurement path: Laura will send the DocuSign envelope on 2026-12-06; please advise if procurement requires a different routing.

Please reply with any gaps by EOD 2026-11-26 so we can hit the delivery date. If helpful we can also do a 30-minute walkthrough of the evidence items on 2026-12-01.

Thanks —
Karthik

From: Marta Lopez <marta@novafin.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: security@novafin.com, diego.ramos@novafin.com
Date: 2026-11-27T09:15:00Z
Subject: Re: Updated MAP and evidence checklist attached (ready for your review)

Karthik — thanks for the quick turnaround and the annotated checklist. Novafin security can accept the proposed timeline: confirmed review week 2026-12-07 to 2026-12-11. A couple of clarifying notes: 1) we only need the redacted audit log sample (full live logs not required), 2) the procurement team asked that the contract route include our signature block for the EU entity (I will share the exact DocuSign routing preference).

We will flag any critical gaps by 2026-11-26 EOD as requested (will try to get you feedback sooner). Please go ahead with the DocuSign prep and evidence drop on 2026-11-30. Looking forward to the walkthrough on Dec 1 if you have availability.

Best —
Marta
